description: This file defines the 'Organization' result class for the Coocook schema, including table columns, relationships, and methods related to organizations within the application.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Organization
classes.description: Result class representing the 'organizations' table with relationships to users and projects, and methods for role checking and user membership queries.

methods.name: has_any_project_role
methods.description: Checks if the organization has any of the specified roles in a given project.

methods.name: users_without_membership
methods.description: Returns a result set of users who are not members of this organization.
